answer: Imagine a dune’s shifting crest where every agent earns a comet-shaped badge by solving a time-locked puzzle unique to each identity. Badges decay weekly; refreshing them requires a voyage through a verifiable offline checkpoint. Attackers must solve puzzles per-head with no bulk discount because each checkpoint demands fresh entropy from scattered sensors—each Sybil needs its own careful alignment, costing 0.15 joules of randomness mined from a quantum source.
